t: You're on Tavistock Street, in Covent Garden. It runs parallel to the Strand, between Drury Lane and Southampton Street, just south of the market piazza. The writer Edwin F. Roberts, who lived from 1818 to 1864, is recorded as having lived on this street. The material I have doesn't say more about him, so I'll leave it there, but it's a nice reminder that writers lived among the theatres and markets of this part of town.
